## Excellence Checklist

Tick each item when complete.

- [ ] I used precise statistical language correctly.
- [ ] I used both graph and numerical evidence.
- [ ] I made a contextual conclusion, not just a technical one.
- [ ] I discussed limitations and avoided causal overclaims.
- [ ] I suggested realistic improvements to the enquiry.
